title: Tick resolution: the engine counts 192 ticks per quarter note, the manual counts 192 per whole note
zone: none yet. Triage only. If approved the task touches crates/octocore (domain.rs, engine.rs), every golden hash, tests/conformance, and docs/02, docs/03, AGENTS.md, SPEC.md (Scribe and Conductor)
why_risk: changes the tempo of every step the engine plays (steps are four times too fast today) and so every golden hash, timing figure and the 12-tick lookahead
spec_rev: SPEC-0001 r2. Not approved. Raised as decision D0 of specs/SPEC-0001/o4-release-plan.md
artifact: specs/SPEC-0001/o4-release-plan.md section 1.1 and tests/conformance/AMBIGUITIES.md entry 'tick resolution: 192 ticks per quarter note or per whole note'
evidence: reference/manual/pages/p015.txt line 47: '1/192 of a note ... 12/192 = 1/16 of a note'; p016.txt line 4: 'one full note - 192/192'; p067.txt line 5: 'A measure is 16 steps at x1 speed'. So 192 ticks is a whole note.

crates/octocore/src/domain.rs:33-34: TICKS_PER_QUARTER = 192, DEFAULT_STEP_TICKS = 12 '1/16 note at 192 PPQN'; engine.rs:272 samples_per_tick = sample_rate*60/(bpm*192): 125 samples (2.6 ms) per tick at 120 BPM and 48 kHz, so 12 ticks last 31.25 ms where a 1/16 note at 120 BPM is 125 ms
docs/03-sequencer-core.md:43 says both 'PPQN 192' and '12 ticks = 1/16', which are only compatible if 192 is a whole note

Not settled by the manual: the unit BPM counts (quarter notes is the ordinary reading). A real Octopus settles it: at 120 BPM, 16 steps at x1 with default lengths take 2 s (manual reading) or 0.5 s (engine)
